intent: Agents are told to change the canonical source and regenerate instead of editing generated roots.
outcome: The Claude and both Antigravity routers forbid direct edits of the generated roots and require regeneration from the canonical source; AGENTS.md keeps generated output out of commits; CLAUDE.md marks itself generated.

assertions.needle: - Do not directly edit generated/runtime roots such as `.claude/**`, `.codex/**`, `.gemini/**`, `.opencode/**`, or `.autopus/plugins/**`.
- Change the canonical ADK template/source, regenerate, and exclude generated/runtime drift from commits.
- Never directly edit `.claude/**`, `.codex/**`, `.gemini/**`, `.opencode/**`, or `.autopus/plugins/**` generated/runtime surfaces.
- Modify the canonical ADK template/source, regenerate, and keep generated/runtime drift out of commits.

Generated harness files and brainstorm/runtime output stay local
and are not commit candidates.
